about: Every feature the manual lists and where it stands, for players to read: available (since a release), in progress, planned or parked. The port keeps it (engine/notes/, beside the release notes); the site copies it (npm run sync:manual). A feature's tracker ids name the tracker's items it follows. No take numbers or internal names.
